title: Prove exact consecutive mixed-precision batch lengths (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration. For every rational affine scalar increment under half-up rounding at two fixed precisions, determine the complete lengths and counts of consecutive cancellation-safe batches, a sharp longest batch, an attaining start, and the exact frequency of every proposed batch length.

```text
B safe centered residues, signed centered step v, u=abs(v), B=q*u+r
r runs of length q+1; u-r runs of length q; omit zero lengths/counts
longest batch = ceil(B/u)
starts admitting length ell = max(0, B-(ell-1)*u) per source period
```

Rational offsets, signed coefficients, empty safe orbits and integral coefficients are explicit. For coefficient 1/1000, zero offset and two extra bits, the sharp maximum is 250 consecutive inputs, starting at 875 modulo 1000. No 251-input safe batch exists. The written proof unwraps adjacent safe residues into one integer step and counts the resulting chains.

This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit woklerx's [PR1853](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1853) for bounded scalar cancellation/counting, PR1848, Adam Gall's PR1908, Gareth Davidson, Chafik Boukhalfa, Ali Romman and the retained dirty-leaf lineage. PR4881's older affine-box test and PR4878's period-density bound are related context. Their results are credited premises, not audit or scientific replay targets. Interval rotations and Euclidean division are classical; no global literature-priority claim is made.

## Evidence

Before, PR1853 counted safe source inputs on bounded scalar intervals. The new theorem gives their ordered maximal-run histogram and every consecutive-batch frequency without enumerating the source period. `PROOF.md` supplies the unbounded argument; `verify.py` uses a separate literal Fraction-rounding oracle.

Local CPython 3.12.15 checks pass:

- 7,636 coefficient/offset/gap cases, 117,036 literal source points, all 17,948 maximal cyclic runs, 124,672 all-start batch-count comparisons and 6,812 attaining runs.
- 891 literal dirty-target updates on three source/coarse-grid pairs, plus four large-period fixtures with exact endpoints and neighboring failures. The large periods are not enumerated.
- Fifteen boundary/input controls, including asymmetric ties, an empty safe orbit, two distinct positive run lengths, a step near an integer and invalid exact-arithmetic inputs.
- Both warning-strict registered commands pass with identical generated source-hash receipts. Individual final command times are 0.994 and 1.076 seconds, below their 120-second caps. These are replay-budget observations, not speedup claims.
- Registered metadata/replay, committed bytes/modes and declared source ancestry pass at `77ef564e3ab8408a6419d10b18647b785ab133a7`.
- Official export integrity and declared-input coverage pass. Both read-only, Git-free, empty-PATH direct modes reproduce the checkout receipt with all eight export files unchanged. Actual predecessor-text corruption rejects under optimized Python.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/cancellation-safe-batches/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/cancellation-safe-batches/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/cancellation-safe-batches
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/cancellation-safe-batches --check-source-history --check-modes
```

A portable CPython 3.12 executable may replace the path. In a sparse checkout first materialize `research/bounded-grid-rounding-count`. Expected markers are `PASS_CANCELLATION_SAFE_BATCHES`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. Receipts are generated by execution and bind all six package files plus the retained predecessor text. No receipt is handwritten.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The source must remain unchanged; the separately rounded increments are added/subtracted exactly. Internally rounded nonlinear leaves, target rounding, aliasing, overflow, saturation and adaptive grids are outside the theorem. Complete-period frequency does not establish a caller's input distribution. The reference implementation caps rational numerator/denominator sizes at 4096 bits and precision gaps at 256; the proof is uncapped. Python managed allocation is a documented deviation from fixed storage.

This changes the uniform-transfer-audit card to a precision-interface side result. No actual native caller, source reachability, physical scheduler, complete paid precision/storage/movement invoice, supplier or compiler admission is supplied. All five selected assumptions remain. No new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed. Selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were unrun. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

Can an actual rounded-linear caller use one attaining consecutive batch? Pin an inverse pair, prove its exact affine source parameterization and consecutive-index domain, then charge routing and the complete precision/storage bill. Source reachability and a physical caller remain the blockers. No continuing scope is reserved.

## Related open work

No other open PR studying this consecutive mixed-precision run histogram or batch-frequency quantity was identified in the complete cached 572-PR corpus and fresh open-list/Discussion/merged/main searches. PR1853, PR1848, PR4881 and PR4878 are merged predecessors/context. Sparse historical notes, arbitrary diffs and unpublished work remain search limits; no exhaustive novelty claim is made. The advance [CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19375381) records the scope and source.

## CI notes

CI pending. Both registered commands and the required publication checks passed locally at `77ef564e3ab8408a6419d10b18647b785ab133a7`; no hosted scientific certification is claimed yet.

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: isolated. Only six files in `research/cancellation-safe-batches/` are added. Shared code, frozen predecessors and the selected record are unchanged.
